title: docs: a plan step's mem: pointer to a dependsOn task's handoff is dead when the worker reads it, because QA archives that handoff at qa_approve and dependsOn withholds the claim until then; moe-planning's "cite only live names" is checked only at plan time (task-62ec51f1's seat got FileNotFoundError on 11-04 07:32Z)
description:
Filed by hunt #19 (task-443e8eac), lane 2: Serena memory conventions. HEAD 3cd256eb.

PROBLEM: two conventions combine so that a pointer is dead by construction.
- docs/skills/moe-planning/SKILL.md:82-83 and docs/MEMORY.md:86 tell the architect to name memories in plan steps as `mem:<name>` and to "cite only live names". That check can only happen at plan time.
- docs/roles/qa.md:23 and docs/MEMORY.md:78 and :99 retire a task's task-<id>-handoff to _archive/ at moe.qa_approve.
- A dependsOn edge withholds the dependent's WORKING claim until the dependency is DONE, which is after that qa_approve.
- So a step that cites a dependency's handoff (live when planned) always reaches its worker after the handoff was archived.
- Nothing falls back:
  - read_memory refuses the old name (not found) and the _archive/ name (ignored_memory_patterns);
  - Serena's read_file refuses it too, because the ignored_paths has .serena. That contradicts MEMORY.md:80 ("read_file still reads the raw file"); the sibling row named in a comment owns that sentence.
  - qa.md:23's "delete only when no live memory cites it" never sees plan steps.

EVIDENCE (/mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-443e8eac/A/)
- Live: task-62ec51f1 (WORKING) cites mem:task-task-828e7d21602e4cf2a0f242e024db7dea-handoff in step 0, and 828e7d21 is one of its dependsOn.
  - 828e7d21 went DONE at 2026-11-03T20:43:17Z. Its handoff now exists only at .serena/memories/_archive/.
  - The seat's Serena log ~/.serena/logs/2026-11-04/mcp_20261104-093217_2810895.txt (local +02:00) shows (A2-serena-log-excerpt.txt):
    INFO 09:32:28,780 read_memory: memory_name='task-task-828e7d21602e4cf2a0f242e024db7dea-handoff'
    ERROR 09:32:28,785 FileNotFoundError: Memory named 'task-task-828e7d21602e4cf2a0f242e024db7dea-handoff' not found
- A2-dead-pointer-repro.sh runs Serena 1.6.2 on a fixture copy (A2-dead-pointer-out.txt):
  - read_memory(name) -> FileNotFoundError;
  - read_memory('_archive/'+name) -> "matches an ignored_memory_patterns pattern ... Use the read_file tool";
  - read_file(.serena/memories/_archive/...) -> "is ignored; cannot access for safety reasons".
- A2-quantify-out.txt: across .moe/tasks, 12 plan-step pointers name a dependsOn task's handoff. Of those handoffs, 9 were archived BEFORE the citing step started, 1 after, and 2 are live.

FIX DIRECTION (docs only)
- moe-planning SKILL.md:82-83: forbid citing another task's task-<id>-handoff in a plan step, and give the reason (QA retires it at qa_approve, before any dependent can claim). The plan quotes the needed fact in the step, or cites a gotcha-/pattern-/decision- memory. Do not name there which file hides _archive/; the sibling row moves that source.
- MEMORY.md:86: restate the same rule in place.
- qa.md:23, in place with no new line (the role-doc cap is 40, and qa.md has 36): before retiring, fold any fact a dependent row's plan relies on into a topic memory.
- Regenerate packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/skillFiles.ts and initFiles.ts in a Linux clone with history (`git clone --shared`; `npm ci && npm run generate-init-files && npm run generate-skill-files` in its packages/moe-daemon), and apply the generated hunks with the session's own editor. Never run npm run build in the shared checkout; see mem:gotcha-moe-doc-generated-artifacts.

FILES: docs/skills/moe-planning/SKILL.md, docs/MEMORY.md (:86 only), docs/roles/qa.md, packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/skillFiles.ts, packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts.

PLACEMENT: shares docs/MEMORY.md with the Serena archive-hiding row filed by the same hunt (named in a comment). That row owns MEMORY.md:80 and :139-143; this row owns :86. There is no dependsOn.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: The planning docs forbid a plan step from citing another task's task-<id>-handoff or task-<id>-qa-handoff. QA retires those at moe.qa_approve, before any dependsOn dependent can claim, so such a pointer is dead when the worker reads it. The docs tell the planner to quote the needed fact or cite a gotcha-/pattern-/decision- memory instead. qa.md tells QA to fold the facts an open dependent task's plan cites from the handoffs before retiring them, and to delete a handoff only when no live memory or open task's plan cites it. planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1) A daemon guard that refuses to let QA archive a handoff an open plan cites. Rejected: archiving is a file move outside the daemon.
2) Tell workers to read `_archive/` via the host's reader. Rejected: it treats the symptom, and Serena refuses _archive/ names.
3) Chosen: stop the dead pointer at its source, in the planning rule, and have QA fold any fact an existing plan already cites. Docs only, plus the vendored mirrors.
